SELECT r.room_id AS roomId, r.room_type AS roomType, r.title AS title, me.last_read_message_id AS lastReadMessageId, lm.message_id AS lastMessageId, lm.sender_id AS lastSenderId, lm.content AS lastContent, lm.deleted_at AS lastDeletedAt, lm.created_at AS lastSentAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_messages u WHERE u.room_id = r.room_id AND u.sender_id <> #{userId} AND u.message_id > COALESCE(me.last_read_message_id, 0) ) AS unreadCount FROM dm_members me JOIN dm_rooms r ON r.room_id = me.room_id LEFT JOIN dm_messages lm ON lm.message_id = (SELECT MAX(m.message_id) FROM dm_messages m WHERE m.room_id = r.room_id) WHERE me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.left_at IS NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dm_members cm JOIN users cu ON cu.user_id = cm.user_id WHERE cm.room_id = r.room_id AND cm.user_id <> #{userId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL AND cu.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
AND (COALESCE(lm.message_id, 0) < #{beforeLastMessageId} OR (COALESCE(lm.message_id, 0) = #{beforeLastMessageId} AND r.room_id < #{beforeRoomId}))
ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.message_id, 0) DESC, r.room_id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_messages u WHERE u.room_id = me.room_id AND u.sender_id <> #{userId} AND (me.last_read_message_id IS NULL OR u.message_id > me.last_read_message_id)) ), 0) FROM dm_members me WHERE me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.left_at IS NULL
